outgoing.name: Archaeology
outgoing.excerpt: The caves of Cheddar Gorge in particular have preserved much archaeology as flood waters have washed artifacts into the caves and preserved them in silt.

outgoing.name: Biodiversity
outgoing.excerpt: Much of the Mendip Hills is open calcareous grassland which supports a large variety of wild flowering plants and insects.

outgoing.name: Cattle
outgoing.excerpt: Grazing by rabbits, sheep and cattle maintains the grassland habitat.

outgoing.name: Coin
outgoing.excerpt: The silver coinage of the Dobunni and Durotriges is likely to reflect the availability of silver from the mines.
